capabilities: Create a trip note with Itinerary, Packing List, Accommodation, and Budget sub-notes via a New Trip modal
Add itinerary days with an Add Itinerary Day command
Generate a pre-populated packing list with categorised checkboxes
Browse trips in a sidebar sorted by status (current/upcoming/past)
Configure the trips folder in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for planning trips, so travelers must manually assemble itinerary, packing, and accommodation notes.
summary: Trip planning plugin that creates trip notes with itinerary, packing list, accommodation, and budget sub-notes plus a trips sidebar.
